digest.component_or_area: plan clarity-scoring floor / ticket-store adversarial audit
propositions: Revise the clarity floor into a small deterministic set of rules intended to have zero false positives, judged by forward soundness rather than historical convention.
Use closed tickets carrying signed plan-review and completion-verifier attestations as an adversarial counterexample corpus, narrowing or rejecting any rule that has a legitimate match.
Retain as hard clarity floor: acceptance-criteria checkbox items whose fully joined body is non-whitespace, with zero historical counterexamples found.

Retain as narrowed hard floor: unresolved sentinels (TBD/TODO/FIXME/???) only in value/assignment positions within exact active execution sections, suppressing removal/negation assertions and dropping the undefined history-section exclusion.
Demote exact-duplicate acceptance-criteria items to advisory only, since a repeated global gate is redundant but not unexecutable.
Move file-impact path/reason integrity to write-schema validation and [rebar:id] direct-edge checks to the grounding exception path, since neither is a raw clarity signal.
